0. Load ETDA Trusted List (when a transaction needs it)
[CONDITION] before this flow (setup , outside the system) : the issuing agency is registered in iss.txt (DID , keys , credential types)
and DW Core in wp.txt as wallet provider (certificate for WUA signatures , location of the WUA status lists) | WUA = WIA and key attestation
Thai VC ARF 2.0 DRAFT 0 9.9 (MUST) , 10.4.2
[SPEC] steps in the ETDA Trusted List Load sequence (first tab) | DW Core loads iss.txt (section 7) , VCVP Core loads wp.txt (section 8)
[SPEC] Trusted List not usable (TRUST_LIST_EXPIRED / TRUST_LIST_UNAVAILABLE) : the calling step answers 503 Service Unavailable + Retry-After: 300
not the trust failure reason of that step , as in the ETDA Trusted List Load sequence
[SPEC] /ssi endpoints that pass the engine through (VCVP Core 11 , 12 , 13 , 15 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 31) : an engine error goes back to the caller in the VCVP error format (error , vcvp_failure_reason)
the audit record keeps FailureReason and EngineCalls , no table changes
7. DW Core Resolves the Credential Offer (inside request 1.2)
[STANDARD] OpenID4VCI 1.0
• 13.4 (MUST NOT) sensitive data only through a fully trusted server part of the wallet
• 13.5 (MUST) the Wallet validates the Credential Issuer
• 13.10 (MUST) a stored Bearer access token is kept secure
[SPEC] DW Core is the fully trusted server part of the wallet , it holds the pre-authorized_code and the access token (stored encrypted , not logged , not sent to the app)
and makes every protocol call , the app signs and checks , the issuer trust check stays on the app
[SPEC] URLs from an offer or a QR are called only over https and never to internal addresses

9.2 Secure Local Storage and Access Policy
[SPEC] app security baseline (set once in the app , not per credential)
target : OWASP MASVS-STORAGE level L2 (the library provides only L1 , the gap must be implemented)
secure local storage : Android EncryptedSharedPreferences / Room encrypted DB , iOS Keychain
envelope encryption : KEK in secure hardware protects DEK on disk , DEK encrypts the data files
file protection : unreadable while the screen is locked , not only until first unlock after boot
access : biometric / PIN / device unlock
personal data : no readable claim copies without justification
holder private key : Secure Enclave / Android Keystore / StrongBox , not exportable
usage policy : holder confirmation before presentation , holder signing before VP submission

Notify credential_accepted with notification_id + access token | POST notification_endpoint = /ssi/openid4vci/final-1.0/{credentialSchemaId}/notification (VCVP Core 19)
[STANDARD] RFC 9449
• 7.1 (MUST) a DPoP-bound access token is sent with the DPoP scheme and a DPoP proof
[ENGINE RULE] the engine declines a reused DPoP proof (401 invalid_dpop_proof , tested on engine 1.89.3)
[ENGINE RULE] the engine sets ACCEPTED when the credential is issued , not on notification
credential_accepted does not change state
credential_failure → ERROR | credential_deleted → REJECTED
ERROR and REJECTED set the Token Status List entry to INVALID , suspend , reactivate and revoke are refused afterwards (400 BR_0366)
